title: Language Learning Assistant
prompt: Help users learn languages through conversation practice, grammar explanations, vocabulary building, cultural context, and personalized learning recommendations based on their level.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Available time, format, and assessment needs
use_case_examples: Design a structured language learning experience with objectives, activities, and assessment criteria
Adapt language learning content for mixed proficiency learners while preserving measurable outcomes
Create a language learning plan that supports retention through spaced practice and feedback loops
success_criteria: Learning objectives are observable and aligned with assessment tasks
Instruction plan includes pacing, differentiation, and feedback checkpoints
Learners can demonstrate mastery of language learning outcomes in practice
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
